shared.error.role_already_granted: The user already has this role at that unit.
shared.error.org_unit_cycle: A unit cannot be placed under one of its own sub-units.
shared.error.org_unit_misplaced: Invalid position: legal entities and groups cannot sit under a legal entity; branches and departments must sit under one.
shared.error.legal_fields_company_only: Tax code, legal name and address are for legal entities only.

shared.devui.name: Name
shared.form.discard_message: All unsaved changes on this form will be lost.
shared.devui.avatars_hint: Initials on a colour derived from the name, so a person keeps one colour on every screen; beside the name where there is room.
shared.devui.icon_buttons_hint: Icon only when the meaning is plain; always with a tooltip and a screen-reader label.
shared.devui.menus_hint: What does not earn a button sits behind "…": in a page header beyond three buttons, at the end of a row with two or more actions. A destructive action comes last, after a rule.
shared.devui.links_hint: A link goes somewhere and is a real <a>, so it opens in a new tab; doing something on the page is a button, even when it looks like a link.
shared.devui.badges_hint: A badge always names the state. The four document colours are fixed; a module's own progress uses neutral or info so it never reads as one of them.
shared.devui.alerts_hint: At the top of the region it is about, coloured by meaning, always with an icon. A document-level error is role="alert"; a field's error sits under the field, not here.
shared.devui.toasts_hint: Short messages at the bottom right (top centre below 1024px) about something that already happened. Never ask a question in a toast; an error about the current form stays next to its cause.
shared.devui.case_toast_success: Success after a save: gone after 3 seconds
shared.devui.case_toast_error: A background job failed while the user was elsewhere: stays until closed
shared.devui.case_toast_undo: A reversible change already applied: Undo for 5 seconds
shared.devui.toast_job_failed: Payroll calculation failed. Open the payroll to see why.
shared.devui.tabs_hint: Tabs split a page into parts and live on the URL; a switch only changes how one feed is viewed.
shared.devui.overlays_hint: A tooltip only names a control without text. A popover holds a small choice tied to the button that opens it. Both float, so both cast a shadow.
shared.devui.field_list_hint: A record's read-only facts: dimmed label on the left, value on the right; a value may be a link or a badge; an empty one reads "—".
shared.devui.tree_hint: A hierarchy such as the org chart: each branch folds, guide lines join it to its parent.
shared.devui.tiles_hint: Home and overview pages: a count opens its list, a link tile opens a page.
shared.devui.sections_hint: A titled region of a page that is not a form. Inside a form use FormSection; on a record page use a Panel card.
shared.devui.case_primary: Primary: one per place, named by its outcome
shared.devui.case_destructive: Destructive: red text on the page, filled red only to confirm
shared.devui.case_icon_beside: Beside buttons and inputs: the same height
shared.devui.case_icon_remove: Remove a row: grey, never red
shared.devui.case_menu_page: Page header: outlined, before the primary button
shared.devui.case_preview: DocumentPreview: a document read-only, in the inbox or a side panel
shared.devui.headers_hint: Breadcrumbs, title and the page's actions, as Page draws them. The breadcrumb links to the pages above; on a record it ends with the record itself.
shared.devui.case_header_list: List or overview: breadcrumbs, title, description, one primary action
shared.devui.case_header_record: A record: avatar, status, key facts, the breadcrumb ending at the record
shared.devui.case_header_back: A document: back button before the title
shared.devui.cards_hint: A record's values sit in cards (Panel), each group edited in place (EditablePanel); KeyFacts sits under the title.
shared.devui.case_key_facts: KeyFacts: the few figures read first
shared.devui.case_panel: Panel: a framed card with icon and actions on its title line
shared.devui.case_editable_panel: EditablePanel: Edit turns the card into its form; "+ Add" opens it too
shared.devui.case_record_columns: RecordColumns: cards on the left, plain digests with "See all" on the right
shared.devui.activity_hint: Everything that happened to a record in one timeline: comments, changes, status moves and reads, newest first.
shared.devui.case_activity_full: Full feed: comment box, filter, days
shared.devui.case_activity_recent: Digest on an overview: the latest few, with See all
shared.devui.doc_panels_hint: The side column of a document page: who approves and where it stands, then its files.
shared.devui.case_approval: ApprovalPanel: every step, the current one waiting
shared.devui.case_attachments: Attachments: download, add by click or drop
shared.devui.case_stat_tile: StatTile: a count that opens its list; loaded, loading, failed
shared.devui.case_link_tile: LinkTile: a way into an area
shared.devui.case_filter_chip: FilterChip: unset, set, a value too long
shared.devui.case_inline_edit: Editable: click, then Enter saves, Esc cancels
shared.devui.case_form_section: FormSection: every field type, with labels, hints and errors
shared.devui.case_section_stack: One after another: a rule separates them
shared.devui.use_page: a page fits no other template: the home page, an area overview.
shared.devui.avoid_page: a more specific template fits; every other template is built on Page.
shared.devui.use_list: listing documents or master data to find, filter and open; a small configuration list edits each item in a FormModal.
shared.devui.avoid_list: viewing or editing one record: a record has its own page, the side panel only previews.
shared.devui.use_record: one record without a lifecycle: an employee, a customer, a user; key facts in the header, each part a full-width tab, the Overview tab to read and edit each group of values.
shared.devui.avoid_record: the record has a number, a date and a draft, pending, posted lifecycle: use DocumentPage.
shared.devui.use_document: viewing and editing one document, from draft to posted or cancelled, with its approval.
shared.devui.avoid_document: the record has no lifecycle: use DetailPage; never split off a separate edit page.
shared.devui.use_inbox: working through pending items one by one: the list beside the selected item's detail.
shared.devui.avoid_inbox: searching or filtering many records: use ListPage.
shared.devui.use_auth: a screen outside the app shell, before there is a session: sign-in.
shared.devui.avoid_auth: the user is signed in: every screen inside the app uses another template.
shared.devui.case_read_only: Product off but its data still shown: ReadOnlyBanner
shared.devui.case_no_results: Filters hide everything: EmptyState with a way out
shared.devui.case_error: Could not load: ErrorState with Retry
shared.devui.query_view_hint: QueryView picks what a region fed by one query shows. Switch the state to see each one; a screen never writes these branches by hand.
shared.devui.use_action_hint: useAction runs one action of a region: asks first when it cannot be undone, keeps a failure next to the region, toasts a success.
shared.devui.use_action_region: The region's list or content sits here.
shared.devui.case_form_modal: A form or content in a modal: FormModal
shared.devui.case_confirm: Ask before what cannot be undone: useConfirm
shared.devui.case_modal_footer: A modal's own buttons in a band at the bottom: ModalFooter
shared.devui.case_form_fields: Fields of a card edited in place, no section title: FormFields
shared.devui.description: Foundations, principles, and every component and page template in every state.

shared.error.invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the document's current status. Reload to see its new status.
shared.error.period_locked: The period up to {{locked_until}} is locked. Contact accounting if this document needs a change.
shared.error.posting_already_recorded: This document already has posting lines. Cancel it before posting again.

shared.error.legal_entity_changed: A document cannot move to another legal entity.
shared.error.org_unit_has_documents: The unit has documents, so it cannot move to another legal entity.
shared.error.invalid_field: The value of {{field}} is not valid.
shared.error.approval_stale: This submission no longer matches the document (withdrawn or sent again). Reload to see the current one.
shared.error.approval_closed: This step was already decided or the submission is closed. Reload to see its state.
shared.error.no_approver: No approver could be found for this document. Ask an administrator to set up the approval rule or its fallback role.
shared.error.approver_cannot_view: This person cannot view the document, so they could never approve it.
shared.error.invalid_rule: The approval rule is not valid at step {{step}}.
shared.jobs.exported: The Excel file is ready; it can be downloaded for 24 hours.
shared.jobs.file_hint: An .xlsx file of up to 5 MB and 10,000 rows; only the first sheet is read.
shared.error.import_rows_invalid: The file has {{count}} rows with errors, so no row was written. Fix the rows below, then import again.
shared.error.import_columns: The file needs {{expected}} columns but has {{got}}. Use the template, or a file exported from this screen.
shared.error.import_not_excel: The file cannot be read. Choose an Excel .xlsx file.
shared.error.import_too_many_rows: The file has more than {{max}} rows. Split it and import the parts one after another.
shared.error.import_file_gone: The imported file is no longer on the server. Choose it again and import once more.
shared.error.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{max_mb}} MB. Choose a smaller file, or split it into several.
shared.error.file_type_not_allowed: Only PDF, JPEG, PNG, DOCX and XLSX files are accepted.
shared.error.comment_too_long: The comment is longer than {{max}} characters.
shared.error.import_header: Column {{column}} of the header reads "{{got}}" instead of "{{expected}}". The file may be for other data or another period; use the template or a file exported from this screen.
shared.error.invalid_setting_value: That value is not valid for this setting.
shared.error.invalid_code_prefix: A prefix has up to 10 characters and no spaces.

shared.rule.title: Approval rules
shared.rule.description: Each document type has a chain of approval steps. Without a rule, a document takes effect as soon as it is sent.
shared.rule.form_description: Steps run in order; a step with a condition applies only when it holds.
shared.rule.kind.role: Role at the document's org unit
shared.rule.condition_hint: Leave empty to always apply the step.
shared.rule.fallback_hint: A step with no approver goes to the fallback role; holders of this role can also reassign approvers.
shared.rule.max_levels_hint: When the direct manager is the submitter, go up, at most this many levels.
shared.rule.delete_confirm: Delete the approval rule of {{name}}? Documents sent afterwards take effect at once.
shared.discussion.mention_hint: Type @ to mention someone who can view this record. Ctrl+Enter to send.
shared.error.mail_server_missing: No mail server is set up.
shared.error.user_email_missing: Your account has no email address. Add one under Users and try again.
shared.error.mail_unreachable: The mail server cannot be reached; mmerp will retry.
shared.error.mail_auth_failed: The mail server refused the account or password.
shared.error.mail_rejected: The mail server refused to deliver to this address.
shared.error.print_placeholder_unknown: The wording uses a placeholder the template does not offer: {{name}}.

shared.views.name: View name
shared.error.list_view_name_taken: A view with this name already exists.
shared.devui.bulk_hint: Select rows to show the bulk action bar; click a row to open the quick view; drag a column edge to resize it.
shared.devui.inline_hint: Click a value to edit it; Enter saves, Esc cancels.
shared.devui.lines_hint: One row per line; Tab or Enter moves to the next cell.
shared.devui.totals_note: Amounts as of the last save.
shared.devui.long_value: Minh Phat Trading and Engineering Services Co., Ltd
shared.devui.principles_hint: What every screen follows, and the voice of its text.
shared.devui.p_dense: Dense and calm: 14px text, 30px controls, 40px rows; space from the 4px scale, separation from thin borders.
shared.devui.p_flat: Flat until it floats: pages are flat surfaces divided by borders; only overlays cast a shadow.
shared.devui.p_colour: Colour means something: primary marks action and selection, green, orange, red, blue and purple mark state, grey carries the rest.
shared.devui.p_radius: Radius follows role: 4px tags, 6px controls and frames, 8px menus, round for people.
shared.devui.p_one_way: One way per job: two screens doing the same job use the same component.
shared.devui.p_backend: The backend decides, the UI displays: buttons come from allowed actions, messages from error codes.
shared.devui.p_one_page: A record has one page: lists lead to it, a side panel only previews, each card is edited in place.
shared.devui.p_one_primary: One primary action per place, named by its outcome; the rest are secondary or behind "…".
shared.devui.p_undo: Ask before what cannot be undone; offer Undo for what can.
shared.devui.p_errors: Errors stay next to their cause; successes toast; nothing fails silently.
shared.devui.p_url: The URL is the state: filters, sort, page, tab and the open side panel; Back always works.
shared.devui.p_server: The server computes: totals, numbers and statuses come from the API.
shared.devui.voice_short: Short, neutral, impersonal: no "you", no "please", no exclamation marks.
shared.devui.voice_imperative: Imperative for instructions: "Choose the pay period".
shared.devui.voice_sentence: Sentence case everywhere, buttons and titles included.
shared.devui.voice_plain: Plain words over system words: "Posted", never a status or error code.
shared.devui.colour_hint: Screens name a colour by meaning (color="success"), never by step.
shared.devui.colour_steps: 0 tint · 1 badge tint · 6 filled · 7 text on tint · 8 badge text.
shared.devui.ramp_primary: The one primary action, links, focus, selected item; also info.
shared.devui.ramp_discovery: Something new or in beta; nothing else.
shared.devui.token__mantine_color_error: Field errors and the required mark.
shared.devui.token__mantine_color_defaul: Dividers, table rules, frames, outlined buttons.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_input_border: Edges of text fields, a step stronger than border.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_elevation_surf: Group and total rows, tile hover, cells that take no value.
shared.devui.token__mantine_primary_colo: Selected state, everywhere: navigation, menus, options, inbox rows.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_control_height: Every button, input and select, wherever it sits; 40px in form sections and modals.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_side_width: The inbox list; the least a document's side column shrinks to.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_content_width: Forms and a document's main column stop here.
shared.devui.token__mmerp_detail_width: A record's or document's page, both columns.
shared.devui.typography_hint: Inter, lines on a 4px grid; at most three heading levels on a page.
shared.devui.type_h1: Page title, one per page, set by the page template.
shared.devui.type_xs: Captions, column headers, badges, field labels. The minimum size.
shared.devui.type_sm: Body text, table cells, inputs, buttons.
shared.devui.type_xl: Modal titles, stat values in tiles.
shared.devui.weight_600: Field labels, column headers, totals, emphasis.
shared.devui.spacing_hint: A closed 4px scale: a gap that seems to need another value needs another level of layout instead.
shared.devui.space_xxxs: Between a line and its caption.
shared.devui.space_xxs: Icon to its text, label to its input.
shared.devui.space_xs: Controls in one strip, rows of a field list.
shared.devui.space_lg: Between page regions and form sections.
shared.devui.space_xl: Page side padding from 1024px, empty-state padding.
shared.devui.surfaces_hint: A card on the page is framed, never shadowed; only overlays float.
shared.devui.radius_md: Default: buttons, inputs, cards, table frames, modals.
shared.devui.elevation_sunken: Sunken: group and total rows, unavailable cells.
shared.devui.elevation_flat: Flat: the page and everything on it, framed.
shared.devui.elevation_footer: Pinned footer: a form's footer while content scrolls under it.
shared.devui.icons_hint: Tabler, outline, stroke 1.5, always through the icon constant; decorative icons sit next to text.
shared.devui.icon_button: In every button, alerts, icon buttons.
shared.devui.buttons_hint: One primary action per place; destructive actions are quiet until they ask to confirm.
shared.devui.alert_info: Amounts are as of the last payroll run.
shared.devui.alert_success: All timesheets of the period are closed.
shared.devui.alert_warning: Inputs changed after the payroll was computed. Compute it again.
shared.devui.alert_danger: March is locked. Contact accounting to change this document.
shared.devui.alert_discovery: New: print templates can be edited per legal entity.
shared.document.save_first: Save changes before submitting or withdrawing.
shared.document.confirm.withdraw: Withdraw {{number}} to draft? The running approval stops; sending it again starts from step 1.
shared.attachments.drop_hint: Drop files here or click to choose
shared.devui.about_button: Mantine's button, used directly with the variants below; shared/ui has no wrapper.
shared.devui.use_button: an action on a page, in a section, or in a form or dialog footer.
shared.devui.avoid_button: going to another page: use Anchor; a row's actions: put them in MoreActions.
shared.devui.dont_two_primary: Two primary buttons side by side: users cannot tell which step comes first.
